questions.q: What percentage of thoughts is the subconscious responsible for, according to the book?
questions.why: The text says the subconscious handles 95% of thoughts.

questions.q: What is the first action recommended for achieving an imagined life?
questions.why: Planning and defining goals is described as imperative.

questions.q: What does the book advise when plans no longer fit reality?
questions.why: It suggests acknowledging and rebalancing when plans misalign.

questions.q: According to the book, postponing happiness until goals are met is:?
How should one treat failure to make it productive?
questions.why: Analyzing cause and learning from failure is recommended.
